headlines.title: Poll: Americans are anxious, pessimistic and deeply unhappy with Trump ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Weeks ahead of Election Day, 71% of U.S. adults think the country is on the “wrong track.”

headlines.title: Is Iowa a Battleground Again?
headlines.description: How the Hawkeye State became one of the most closely watched battlegrounds of the midterms

headlines.title: 2 killed, 10 injured after woman drives truck through youth soccer game
headlines.description: A 6-year-old boy and 35-year-old man were killed and 10 others were injured when a woman drove a truck through a youth soccer game at a sports complex in Wichita, Kansas, Saturday afternoon, police said. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Obama calls Trump officials’ investigation of Ilhan Omar ‘appalling’
headlines.description: The former president posted a lengthy statement calling President Donald Trump’s treatment of Ilhan Omar a “transparent” effort to intimidate her.

headlines.title: Thanks to familiar miscues, the Dallas Cowboys are off to their worst start in years
headlines.description: The Dallas Cowboys can’t run the ball or stop opposing offenses. Its resulted in their worst record through six games since 2020.

headlines.title: 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Canadian military base
headlines.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Sunday that four service members were killed and dozens more seriously injured in a fire at a military base in Alberta, describing it as one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada’s military on domestic soil. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: U.S. taking Putin’s side would be a ‘historic mistake,’ Zelenskyy says
headlines.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that the U.S. formally siding with Russia’s Vladimir Putin would be a “historic mistake.” All of this comes as the midterms are just over two weeks away and a new NBC News poll shows 71 percent of Americans say the U.S. is on the wrong track. Voters were especially sour on the economy and gas prices. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

headlines.title: Witnesses haunted by what they saw when pickup plowed through a Kansas youth soccer game
headlines.description: The crash at Stryker Sports Complex in Wichita killed a 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man and injured several children and adults.

headlines.title: ‘No conclusive evidence’ of Amelia Earhart’s missing plane found in South Pacific expedition
headlines.description: The expedition said the anomaly captured on satellite imagery, hypothesized to be wreckage of Earhart’s plane, was most likely “a collection of debris.”
